contract.variant: Standing two-hand kettlebell pullover, hands on the horns
contract.counting: One arc overhead, lower behind the head and return
contract.phases: Bell at the hips on long arms; arc up in front of the face to overhead; bend the elbows to lower the bell behind the head; extend and arc back down
contract.contacts: Both feet planted; both hands on the horns; ribs down, no low-back arch
